description: Duplex callback service with one-way initiating calls, required sessions, per-session state, flowed transactions, reliable sessions, and a streamed archive service.

facts.claim: IDispatchService requires a callback contract and an ordered session.
DispatchService stores mutable job state in a PerSession, Reentrant service instance.
The duplex netTcpBinding enables ordered reliable sessions.
IArchiveTransfer sends and receives System.IO.Stream values.

risks.construct: duplex callback plus one-way initiating operation
risks.consequence: Callback lifetime, delivery, ordering, acknowledgement, cancellation, and reconnect behavior require a streaming redesign.
gRPC calls cannot depend on WCF session affinity; state ownership, persistence, concurrency, and correlation must be redesigned.
Ambient distributed transaction flow is not a gRPC transport feature and needs an explicit consistency, saga, or outbox design.
Delivery guarantees, deduplication, replay, ordering, and reconnect semantics must be implemented and observed at the application layer.
The contract needs chunk messages, limits, checksums, cancellation, backpressure, and resume semantics.

questions.prompt: Should job progress use server streaming after a unary start, or one bidirectional stream that also carries commands?
questions.trigger: The WCF service combines a one-way initiating call with callbacks.

questions.prompt: What business invariant does CommitJob protect, and which saga, outbox, or idempotent workflow will replace transaction flow?
Which ordering, retry, deduplication, reconnect, and loss guarantees are actually required?
questions.trigger: Reliable sessions and one-way callbacks are configured.

rpcs.notes: Return an explicit acknowledgement and idempotency token; do not preserve fire-and-forget ambiguity.
Replace callbacks with a cancellable ordered progress stream and explicit reconnect cursor.
Invoke an explicitly designed consistency workflow; never imply transaction propagation.
Stream bounded chunks with offset, checksum, total length, cancellation, and backpressure.
Accept bounded chunks and return a final validation and persistence result.

typeMappings.notes: Keep a monotonic sequence and stable job ID so consumers can detect gaps and resume.
Replace Stream with explicit bytes chunks plus transfer metadata and integrity fields.

workPackages.objective: Define common identity, error, idempotency, observability, and chunking conventions.
Specify dispatch and archive Protobuf services with unary and streaming shapes.
Implement correlated durable job state, concurrency rules, reconnect cursors, and the transaction replacement.
Implement chunked upload/download with limits, cancellation, integrity, and backpressure.
Implement gRPC for .NET services and parity, reconnect, ordering, and failure-injection tests.

expectations: The mandatory target is gRPC for .NET; CoreWCF, REST, and message brokers may be coexistence or implementation details but not replacement targets.
Every duplex, one-way, session, transaction, reliable-delivery, and raw-stream behavior is an explicit redesign risk with an approved decision and executable parity criteria.
The dependency graph is acyclic and keeps shared contract work ahead of independently owned state and streaming work.
